Experience Required 
1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience in consulting, 
government advisory, financial analysis, taxation, public policy, 
programme operations or a related domain. 
Number of Positions 01  
 
 
The Associate will support application due diligence, scheme operations, policy research, data 
management and stakeholder coordination for the Startup India Tax Exemption Scheme. The role 
requires careful financial and business analysis, strong documentation, attention to detail and the 
ability to manage applications and oﬃcial requirements within defined timelines.  
Key Responsibilities  
Application assessment and due diligence 
• Screen and process startup applications in line with applicable legislation, scheme 
guidelines, eligibility conditions, and approved evaluation procedures. 
• Review business, financial, shareholding, innovation, and supporting information for 
completeness, consistency, and decision-making needs. 
• Use AI-assisted tools to support review, such as extracting data from financial statements, 
checking documents for completeness, flagging inconsistencies, and detecting duplicate or 
anomalous applications. Validate all AI outputs manually before relying on them. 
• Prepare structured application summaries, observations, and clarification requests for 
internal review and committee consideration. Use AI summarisation with human verification 
where appropriate. 
• Maintain accurate application records, status trackers, audit trails, and documentation, 
while protecting confidential information. 
Scheme operations and committee coordination 
• Support end-to-end administration of the tax exemption process: application intake, 
scrutiny, scheduling, committee documentation, decisions, and applicant communication. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, government departments, committee members, and other 
stakeholders to ensure timely processing and resolution of pending matters. 
• Track pendency, turnaround time, and recurring operational issues through data analysis, 
and recommend practical process improvements, including automation opportunities. 
• Assist in implementing related regulatory, recognition, and exemption initiatives undertaken 
by Startup India. 
Policy research and framework development 
• Research and benchmark startup taxation, incentive frameworks, eligibility models, and 
international best practices. Use AI research tools where useful, verifying every finding 
against primary sources. 
• Support preparation of policy notes, scheme briefs, consultation material, guidelines, FAQs, 
and implementation frameworks. 
• Analyse applicant feedback and case trends to identify policy ambiguities, procedural gaps, 
and areas needing clarification. Apply text analytics or topic classification to large volumes of 
feedback. 
• Contribute to reviews of the tax exemption framework and to proposals for improving 
access, clarity, and administrative eﬃciency. 
Technology, AI, and process improvement 
 
• Work with technology partners to improve application forms, portal workflows, validation 
rules, dashboards, automation, and user experience. 
• Identify and prioritise AI and automation use cases across the scheme lifecycle, such as 
eligibility pre-checks, document classification, query routing, and drafting standard 
communications. Prepare business cases for them. 
• Translate operational, policy, and AI requirements into BRDs, functional specifications, user 
stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, issue logs, and enhancement requests. 
• Support user-acceptance testing of portal and AI features. For AI features, test accuracy, 
consistency, and edge cases. Monitor resolution of defects, workflow issues, and data 
inconsistencies. 
• Help define safeguards for AI use, covering data privacy (DPDP Act, 2023), confidentiality of 
applicant data, bias checks, explainability, and human-in-the-loop review. 
• Maintain SOPs, process maps, templates, prompt libraries, and knowledge resources for 
consistent scheme administration. 
Data, reporting, and stakeholder support 
• Analyse scheme data, maintain databases, and prepare reports, dashboards (Power BI, 
Tableau, or similar), briefs, presentations, and management inputs. 
• Respond to startup queries and oﬃcial data requests. Analyse queries to identify recurring 
concerns and outreach needs, and support chatbot or knowledge-base improvements where 
applicable. 
• Support inputs for Parliamentary Questions, public grievances, RTI matters, and other 
Government references relating to the scheme. 
• Coordinate with startups and ecosystem partners to improve awareness and understanding 
of tax exemption requirements and processes. 
Qualifications  
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Public Policy, 
Management, Law or a related discipline.  
• One to three years of relevant professional experience in consulting, government advisory, 
financial analysis, taxation, public policy, programme operations or a related domain. 
• Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret financial, business and 
policy information accurately. 
• Excellent drafting and communication skills, including experience preparing reports, 
presentations and oﬃcial correspondence 
• Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, with comfort in structured 
data management and reporting. 
• Ability to manage multiple applications and time-sensitive requirements with accuracy, 
confidentiality and attention to detail. 
Skills and Attributes  
• Experience with tax, regulatory, government or financial-services processes involving 
application assessment and documentation review. 
 
• Understanding of the Indian startup ecosystem, DPIIT recognition and startup-related tax 
incentives. 
• Exposure to e-governance portals, workflow automation, user-acceptance testing or process 
improvement. 
• Familiarity with Government of India reporting formats, committee processes and oﬃcial 
data requirements.

Experience Required 10 years in software development/tech product management with at 
least 4+ years in leadership or architectural role. 
Number of Positions 01  
 
Key Responsibilities  
The position will be responsible for the following:  
Technology Strategy & Architecture  
• Define and maintain the technical roadmap aligned with the strategic objectives of Startup 
India and DPIIT.  
• Be able to define the architecture of scalable, secure, and modular platforms across multiple 
verticals including recognition, applications, mapping tools, dashboards, and analytics. 
Platform Oversight & Development  
• Oversee full-stack development of key portals and initiatives such as Startup India Hub, 
BHASKAR platform, Startup India Seed Fund Scheme, MAARG Mentorship Platform, Investor 
Connect Platform and integrations for public-private collaborations.  
• Ensure end-to-end system design for high availability, performance, and ease of integration 
with third-party and government systems.  
Team Leadership & Vendor Management  
• Drive technical innovation for ecosystem matchmaking, personalization algorithms, 
advanced analytics, and digital credentialing.  
• Coordinate with DPIIT, industry bodies, and state governments to understand and 
implement technology needs. 
Product Innovation & Stakeholder Engagement 
• Drive technical innovation for ecosystem matchmaking, personalization algorithms, 
advanced analytics, and digital credentialing.  
• Coordinate with DPIIT, industry bodies, and state governments to understand and 
implement technology needs. 
Security, Compliance & Performance Optimization 
• Implement data privacy standards, compliance with Indian government digital protocols 
(e.g., MeitY, NIC, GIGW 3.0).  
 
• Work with hosting providers and MSPs (e.g., AWS, NIC, Hitachi Systems) to optimize 
performance and conduct regular audits. 
Qualifications  
• Education: Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or 
associated fields.  
• Experience: 10 years in software development/tech product management with at least 4+ 
years in leadership or architectural role.  
• Backend: Knowledge of programming languages such as (but not limited to) Node.js, Python, 
Java, or similar  
• Frontend: Knowledge of programming languages such as (but not limited to) Angular, React, 
Vue Familiar with recurring used frameworks for eﬃcient builds  
• DevOps: AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, 
Elasticsearch APIs: RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, API Gateways

• Experience with government tech platforms, digital governance projects, or large-scale 
B2B/B2G platforms  
• Prior experience working with Ministry-level initiatives or public policy environments

extensive knowledge of brand management, content creation, and media strategies 
 
3. Recognition _ Deputy General Manager/Senior Manager 
Experience Required 
10 plus years of relevant professional experience in platform 
operations, programme operations, e-governance, technical support, 
service delivery or data operations. 
Number of Positions 01 
 
Key Responsibilities  
The Sr. Manager will lead high -volume portal and application operations, manage service levels, 
supervise the operations team and coordinate technology and process improvements. The role 
requires strong operational leadership, data -led decision making, quality-control discipline and the 
ability to resolve complex cases and platform  issues while ensuring accurate, responsive and 
compliant service delivery.  
 
 
Platform Operations & Service Delivery  
• Lead processing and evaluation operations for Startup Recognition, DeepTech and related 
applications and establish mechanisms to reduce pendency and turnaround time.  
• Define operating plans, workload allocation, review checkpoints and escalation  mechanisms 
for high-volume digital workflows.  
• Monitor performance against Service Level Agreements and quality standards and  
intervene on bottlenecks, backlogs and recurring operational risks.  
• Ensure consistent application of scheme guidelines, standard operating procedures  
and approved evaluation criteria across the team.  
Query Management & Stakeholder Support  
• Oversee the Startup India query portal, including categorisation, allocation, escalation, quality 
review and timely resolution of stakeholder queries.  
• Periodically review standard response templates, frequently asked questions,  knowledge 
resources and escalation protocols.  
• Analyse query and grievance trends to identify systemic issues, communication gaps and 
opportunities for process or portal improvement.  
• Coordinate resolution of complex or sensitive cases with policy, recognition, regulatory, 
technology and senior Government stakeholders.  
Data, Reporting & Official References  
• Own extraction, validation and analysis of platform data and develop dashboards, 
management reports and decision-support inputs for senior oﬃcers.  
• Review and quality -assure responses to Right to Information applications, Parliamentary 
Questions, public grievances, data requests and other oﬃcial references.  
• Maintain source traceability, data definitions, request logs, approval records and audit-ready 
reporting documentation.  
• Provide reliable operational insights for programme reviews, policy improvements, resource 
planning and leadership decision-making.  
Technology, Controls & Continuous Improvement  
• Coordinate with technology teams and service providers to resolve outages, defects, data 
issues, workflow gaps and system-performance concerns.  
• Translate operational requirements into functional specifications, test cases and 
enhancement requests and lead user-acceptance testing.  
• Drive workflow automation, user -experience improvements and operational readiness for 
new recognition categories, schemes and platform modules.  
• Develop and institutionalise standard operating procedures, escalation matrices,  process 
maps, control mechanisms, audit trails and continuity plans.  
Team, Vendor & Governance Management  
• Lead and guide the portal operations team, allocate workloads, review performance, build 
capability and ensure timely escalation of complex cases.  
• Establish periodic operating reviews, quality audits, productivity metrics and corrective-action 
mechanisms.  
• Manage coordination with outsourced service providers, vendors and implementation 
partners and review delivery against agreed requirements.  
 
• Promote a culture of accuracy, service orientation, ownership, documentation and continuous 
improvement.  
Qualifications & Experience  
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Applications, Information Systems,Commerce, 
Management or a related discipline; a relevant Master’s degree is preferred.  
• 10 plus years of relevant professional experience in platform operations, programme 
operations, e-governance, technical support, service delivery or data operations.  
• Demonstrated experience independently managing teams and high-volume digital application 
or query workflows.  
• Strong proficiency in spreadsheet, dashboard and data tools, with the ability to convert 
operational data into actionable management insights.  
• Excellent stakeholder coordination, written communication, process documentation and 
problem-solving skills.  
• Sound understanding of service -level management, workflow controls, quality assurance, 
escalation management and continuous improvement. 
4. Recognition _ Associate 
Experience Required 0-4 years of work experience Consulting Firm / Government Advisory/ 
Leading corporate will be preferred) 
Number of Positions 01 
 
Key Responsibilities  
Recognition and due diligence 
• Conduct due diligence of startups and incubators as per defined processes and identify gaps 
and opportunities to improve them. 
• Screen startup and incubator applications, and design AI -assisted triage (e.g., document 
checks, eligibility flagging, duplicate or anomaly detection) with human review of final 
decisions. 
• Organise and support regular meetings with high -level committees and ministries, including 
preparing agendas, data packs, and minutes. 
Data analysis and AI enablement 
• Manage and analyse large databases of applications and recognised startups, keeping data 
quality, consistency, and security high. 
• Build dashboards and MIS reports (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) to track recognition status, 
sector trends, regional distribution, and scheme uptake. 
• Identify use cases for AI and automation, such as summarising applications, classifying sectors, 
routing grievances, and drafting standard responses. Write clear business requirements for 
these use cases and work with technical teams or vendors to deliver them. 
• Assess AI outputs for accuracy, bias, and explainability, and make sure their use follows 
government data protection norms, including the DPDP Act. 
Regulatory and policy support 
• Assist with regulatory aspects of startup recognition, tax exemptions, and DPIIT schemes. 
• Support DPIIT oﬃcials in formulating policies, schemes, and measures with evidence -based 
analysis, benchmarking, and data insights. 
• Provide inputs for introducing and implementing new processes, including digital and AI -
driven workflows, in line with the Department’s objectives. 
 
Stakeholder engagement 
• Handhold startups and government departments on entrepreneurship topics to build a 
conducive startup ecosystem, including awareness of AI adoption and digital tools. 
• Resolve queries and grievances of startups and other stakeholders within stipulated timelines, 
using tools like ticketing systems and AI-assisted responses to improve turnaround. 
• Address ad hoc requests from DPIIT, such as reports, briefs, presentations, and data notes. 
Qualifications  
• Bachelor's or master's degree (CA / CS / Lawyer from Premier Institute will be preferred)  
• 0-4 years of work experience Consulting Firm / Government Advisory/ Leading corporate will 
be preferred)  
• Ability to work in teams and independently take responsibility of delivering key results 
Excellent Research, Communications, and Analytical Skills  
• Experience in Policy facilitation, Project Management with the State Govt. or Govt. of India is 
plus 
5. Special Projects _ Deputy General Manager/Senior Manager/Manager 
Experience Required Minimum 15 years of overall IT experience with at least 8 years in 
solution/enterprise architecture roles 
Number of Positions 1  
 
Key Responsibilities    
• Designing and running national-scale startup programs and challenges  
• End-to-end ownership of flagship initiatives (problem framing, eligibility, evaluation 
frameworks, jury coordination, outcomes tracking), similar to Startup Maharathi and 
Elevate-type programs.  
• Ecosystem coordination with VCs, accelerators, corporates, and state governments  
• Acting as the operating bridge between Startup India/DPIIT, venture funds, industry bodies 
(FICCI-type), and state innovation agencies for co-created programs and capital facilitation.  
• Policy-linked execution and stakeholder management  
• Working closely with senior policymakers and government divisions to translate policy intent 
into executable startup initiatives, dashboards, and measurable outcomes.  
• Data-driven ecosystem insights and reporting  
• Building and managing startup databases, visibility dashboards, sectoral insights, and 
outcome reporting for internal reviews, ministerial briefs, and public-facing impact 
narratives.  
• Founder enablement and capacity-building programs  
• Designing workshops, playbooks, and clinics on fundraising, capital readiness, and GTM 
support, in collaboration with partners like cloud providers, corporates, and ecosystem 
enablers.  
• Special initiatives and high-priority pilots  
• Handling fast-moving, ambiguous projects—cross-border startup corridors, new incentive 
pilots, or thematic missions, where structure, execution speed, and ecosystem credibility 
matter.

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business/Commerce, Data Management, Public Policy, 
Economics, Engineering.  
• 4-6 years of experience in data management, MIS reporting, policy monitoring, government 
consulting, and startups.  
• Proficiency in Microsoft Oﬃce (Advanced Excel, PowerPoint); knowledge of BI tools (e.g., 
Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.  
• Fast learner possessing a strong analytical mindset with experience in data 
management/analysis, research, policy and consulting.

Experience Required 
2-5 years of relevant work experience in roles such as startup 
facilitation, investment promotion, government consulting, or 
corporate strategy. 
Number of Positions 01  
 
This role involves strategic alignment of Startup India programs, stakeholder engagement, and 
facilitating ecosystem development across public and private sectors. Key responsibilities include 
policy inputs, capacity building, regional engagement, and contributing to high-impact projects in 
sustainability, creative economy, and investment summits. Candidates should possess exceptional 
communication skills, a strong grasp of entrepreneurship policies, and 2-5 years of relevant 
experience in startup facilitation or strategy roles.  
Key Responsibilities  
The position will be responsible for the following:  
Strategic Initiatives   
• Align Startup India’s initiatives with national and regional priorities, ensuring effective 
execution of strategic projects and policies. 
• Contribute to policy inputs and support the design and rollout of startup-focused programs 
and frameworks.  
• Support efforts to enhance ease of doing business for startups through streamlined 
facilitation and engagement.  
Stakeholder Engagement   
• Collaborate with stakeholders across the startup ecosystem, including incubators, 
accelerators, investors, startups, and industry associations.  
• Facilitate communication between government oﬃcials and external stakeholders to 
address challenges and support entrepreneurship.  
• Assist leadership in decision-making, program management, and implementing critical 
initiatives.   
Capacity Building  
 
• Assist in organizing and implementing capacity-building programs for various stakeholders, 
focusing on knowledge-sharing and skill development. -  
• Identify gaps in skills and resources and initiate partnerships to address these effectively.  
State and Regional Engagement  
• Build a strong understanding of the socio-economic and business landscape across     
different states, with a focus on policies, clusters, and startup-friendly initiatives. -  
• Engage with state-level stakeholders to promote startup development and resolve 
challenges faced by entrepreneurs at the grassroots level.  
 
 
Special Projects  
• Participate in special initiatives focusing on emerging areas such as sustainability 
decarbonization, creative economy, and sectoral innovation. 
• Support the organization and execution of high-impact summits, events, and external 
engagement activities to strengthen the startup ecosystem.  
Qualifications  
• Bachelor’s or Post-Graduate Degree in Business Administration, Public Policy, Management, 
Engineering, Finance, or other relevant fields from a reputed institution.  
Experience  
• 2-5 years of relevant work experience in roles such as startup facilitation, investment 
promotion, government consulting, or corporate strategy.  
• Prior experience in working with government projects or initiatives is advantageous.  
Skills and Attributes  
• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and client relationship management 
skills.  
• Strong proficiency in MS Oﬃce tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).  
• Self-motivated with the ability to manage high-pressure situations and work independently.  
• Familiarity with public sector processes, entrepreneurship policies, and the startup 
ecosystem is a plus. 
 
7. Income Tax Exemption _ Associate 
Experience Required 
1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience in consulting, 
government advisory, financial analysis, taxation, public policy, 
programme operations or a related domain. 
Number of Positions 01  
 
 
The Associate will support application due diligence, scheme operations, policy research, data 
management and stakeholder coordination for the Startup India Tax Exemption Scheme. The role 
requires careful financial and business analysis, strong documentation, attention to detail and the 
ability to manage applications and oﬃcial requirements within defined timelines.  
Key Responsibilities  
Application assessment and due diligence 
• Screen and process startup applications in line with applicable legislation, scheme 
guidelines, eligibility conditions, and approved evaluation procedures. 
• Review business, financial, shareholding, innovation, and supporting information for 
completeness, consistency, and decision-making needs. 
• Use AI-assisted tools to support review, such as extracting data from financial statements, 
checking documents for completeness, flagging inconsistencies, and detecting duplicate or 
anomalous applications. Validate all AI outputs manually before relying on them. 
• Prepare structured application summaries, observations, and clarification requests for 
internal review and committee consideration. Use AI summarisation with human verification 
where appropriate. 
• Maintain accurate application records, status trackers, audit trails, and documentation, 
while protecting confidential information. 
Scheme operations and committee coordination 
• Support end-to-end administration of the tax exemption process: application intake, 
scrutiny, scheduling, committee documentation, decisions, and applicant communication. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, government departments, committee members, and other 
stakeholders to ensure timely processing and resolution of pending matters. 
• Track pendency, turnaround time, and recurring operational issues through data analysis, 
and recommend practical process improvements, including automation opportunities. 
• Assist in implementing related regulatory, recognition, and exemption initiatives undertaken 
by Startup India. 
Policy research and framework development 
• Research and benchmark startup taxation, incentive frameworks, eligibility models, and 
international best practices. Use AI research tools where useful, verifying every finding 
against primary sources. 
• Support preparation of policy notes, scheme briefs, consultation material, guidelines, FAQs, 
and implementation frameworks. 
• Analyse applicant feedback and case trends to identify policy ambiguities, procedural gaps, 
and areas needing clarification. Apply text analytics or topic classification to large volumes of 
feedback. 
• Contribute to reviews of the tax exemption framework and to proposals for improving 
access, clarity, and administrative eﬃciency. 
Technology, AI, and process improvement 
 
• Work with technology partners to improve application forms, portal workflows, validation 
rules, dashboards, automation, and user experience. 
• Identify and prioritise AI and automation use cases across the scheme lifecycle, such as 
eligibility pre-checks, document classification, query routing, and drafting standard 
communications. Prepare business cases for them. 
• Translate operational, policy, and AI requirements into BRDs, functional specifications, user 
stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, issue logs, and enhancement requests. 
• Support user-acceptance testing of portal and AI features. For AI features, test accuracy, 
consistency, and edge cases. Monitor resolution of defects, workflow issues, and data 
inconsistencies. 
• Help define safeguards for AI use, covering data privacy (DPDP Act, 2023), confidentiality of 
applicant data, bias checks, explainability, and human-in-the-loop review. 
• Maintain SOPs, process maps, templates, prompt libraries, and knowledge resources for 
consistent scheme administration. 
Data, reporting, and stakeholder support 
• Analyse scheme data, maintain databases, and prepare reports, dashboards (Power BI, 
Tableau, or similar), briefs, presentations, and management inputs. 
• Respond to startup queries and oﬃcial data requests. Analyse queries to identify recurring 
concerns and outreach needs, and support chatbot or knowledge-base improvements where 
applicable. 
• Support inputs for Parliamentary Questions, public grievances, RTI matters, and other 
Government references relating to the scheme. 
• Coordinate with startups and ecosystem partners to improve awareness and understanding 
of tax exemption requirements and processes. 
Qualifications  
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Public Policy, 
Management, Law or a related discipline.  
• One to three years of relevant professional experience in consulting, government advisory, 
financial analysis, taxation, public policy, programme operations or a related domain. 
• Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret financial, business and 
policy information accurately. 
• Excellent drafting and communication skills, including experience preparing reports, 
presentations and oﬃcial correspondence 
• Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, with comfort in structured 
data management and reporting. 
• Ability to manage multiple applications and time-sensitive requirements with accuracy, 
confidentiality and attention to detail. 
Skills and Attributes  
• Experience with tax, regulatory, government or financial-services processes involving 
application assessment and documentation review. 
 
• Understanding of the Indian startup ecosystem, DPIIT recognition and startup-related tax 
incentives. 
• Exposure to e-governance portals, workflow automation, user-acceptance testing or process 
improvement. 
• Familiarity with Government of India reporting formats, committee processes and oﬃcial 
data requirements. 
8. Information Technology _Deputy General Manager 
Experience Required 10 years in software development/tech product management with at 
least 4+ years in leadership or architectural role. 
Number of Positions 01  
 
Key Responsibilities  
The position will be responsible for the following:  
Technology Strategy & Architecture  
• Define and maintain the technical roadmap aligned with the strategic objectives of Startup 
India and DPIIT.  
• Be able to define the architecture of scalable, secure, and modular platforms across multiple 
verticals including recognition, applications, mapping tools, dashboards, and analytics. 
Platform Oversight & Development  
• Oversee full-stack development of key portals and initiatives such as Startup India Hub, 
BHASKAR platform, Startup India Seed Fund Scheme, MAARG Mentorship Platform, Investor 
Connect Platform and integrations for public-private collaborations.  
• Ensure end-to-end system design for high availability, performance, and ease of integration 
with third-party and government systems.  
Team Leadership & Vendor Management  
• Drive technical innovation for ecosystem matchmaking, personalization algorithms, 
advanced analytics, and digital credentialing.  
• Coordinate with DPIIT, industry bodies, and state governments to understand and 
implement technology needs. 
Product Innovation & Stakeholder Engagement 
• Drive technical innovation for ecosystem matchmaking, personalization algorithms, 
advanced analytics, and digital credentialing.  
• Coordinate with DPIIT, industry bodies, and state governments to understand and 
implement technology needs. 
Security, Compliance & Performance Optimization 
• Implement data privacy standards, compliance with Indian government digital protocols 
(e.g., MeitY, NIC, GIGW 3.0).  
 
• Work with hosting providers and MSPs (e.g., AWS, NIC, Hitachi Systems) to optimize 
performance and conduct regular audits. 
Qualifications  
• Education: Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or 
associated fields.  
• Experience: 10 years in software development/tech product management with at least 4+ 
years in leadership or architectural role.  
• Backend: Knowledge of programming languages such as (but not limited to) Node.js, Python, 
Java, or similar  
• Frontend: Knowledge of programming languages such as (but not limited to) Angular, React, 
Vue Familiar with recurring used frameworks for eﬃcient builds  
• DevOps: AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, 
Elasticsearch APIs: RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, API Gateways

Job Description 
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Manager – Administration to lead and strengthen the 
administrative, procurement, contracting and operational ecosystem of the Digital India BHASHINI Division 
(DIBD). 
The incumbent will be responsi ble for end -to-end government procurement, tendering, vendor and contract 
management, manpower sourcing and engagement, including translation and language -related services, 
freelance agencies and specialised service providers. The role will also oversee IT  and infrastructure support, 
facilities management, administrative budgeting, compliance and operational coordination. 
The position requires practical expertise in GeM, CPPP, GFR 2017 and Government procurement procedures, 
along with the ability to develop an efficient, transparent and scalable administrative and vendor ecosystem to 
support BHASHINI's expanding programmes, projects and organisational requirements. 
Role & Responsibilities 
1. Lead end-to-end procurement activities, including procurement planning, preparation of tender documents, 
bid evaluation, vendor selection, contract negotiation and finalisation through GeM, CPPP and other 
applicable procurement mechanisms. 
2. Ensure compliance with GFR 2017, Government procurement guidelines and applicable policies, including 
preparation and processing of RFPs, RFEs, RFQs, EOIs, technical and financial bid evaluation, Reverse 
Auctions and contract awards. 
3. Manage procurement and engagement of manpower resources through Software Development Agencies 
(SDAs), third -party service providers and other approved contractual arrangements, ensuring timely 
availability of resources as per organisational requirements. 
4. Facilitate the sourcing, empanelment and engagement of translation agencies, language service providers, 
translators, interpreters, linguistic experts, freelancers and other specialise d resources required for 
BHASHINI projects and initiatives. 
5. Develop and manage an appropriate ecosystem for engaging freelance agencies and individual professionals 
for project-based assignments, including empanelment, scope of work, rate contracts, service agreements, 
deliverable-based payments and performance monitoring, in accordance with applicable procurement and 
financial rules. 
6. Manage vendor relationships, contractual agreements, S ervice Level Agreements (SLAs), deliverables, 
performance assessment, contract renewals, dispute resolution and contract closure. 
7. Oversee administrative coordination for IT infrastructure and support services, including hardware, 
software, networking, LAN, internet connectivity, IT assets, technical support arrangements and 
coordination with internal IT teams and external service providers to ensure uninterrupted office operations. 
8. Oversee office infrastructure, facilities management, logistics, housekeeping, security, maintenance, asset 
management, inventory control and other essential administrative services. 
9. Plan and monitor administra tive and procurement budgets, track expenditure and commitments, ensure 
timely processing of procurement-related payments and identify opportunities for cost optimisation. 
10. Maintain comprehensive procurement and contract records, ensure proper documentation and audit trails, 
 
 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
 
                                                                                                                                                                                               Page 3 of 4 
coordinate internal and external audits and facilitate timely resolution of audit observations. 
11. Establish and maintain a structured database and empanelment framework of vendors, agencies, freelancers 
and service providers across relevant domains to facilitate timely and transparent project -based 
engagements. 
12. Lead and guide the administration team, coordinate with HR, Finance, Technical and Project teams, and work 
with Government departments, institutions and external stakeholders to facilitate organisational 
requirements. 
13. Develop and implement administrative policies, SOPs and digital workflows to  improve procurement 
efficiency, service delivery, resource utilisation and institutional accountability. 
14. Undertake official visits to vendor locations, project sites, offices and other locations, as required, for 
procurement coordination, inspections, monitoring and administrative operations. 
15. Undertake any other administrative, procurement, operational or institutional assignments entrusted by the 
Competent Authority for strengthening BHASHINI's administrative ecosystem and supporting its 
organisational objectives.
